key_fields.name: EDIT-DATE-CCYYMMDD
key_fields.meaning: Entry point: marks the date invalid and falls through the year, month, day, combination and LE paragraphs; callers PERFORM it THRU EDIT-DATE-CCYYMMDD-EXIT.

key_fields.name: EDIT-DAY-MONTH-YEAR
key_fields.meaning: Rejects day 31 in short months, day 30 in February and day 29 in February outside leap years (YY=00 divisible by 400, else by 4); skips LE validation unless all three parts are valid.

key_fields.name: EDIT-DATE-LE
key_fields.meaning: Calls CSUTLDTC with format YYYYMMDD; non-zero severity is an input error.

key_fields.name: EDIT-DATE-LE-EXIT
key_fields.meaning: Exit label that also contains SET WS-EDIT-DATE-IS-VALID TO TRUE.

key_fields.name: EDIT-DATE-CCYYMMDD-EXIT
key_fields.meaning: End of the full date edit range.

key_fields.name: EDIT-DATE-OF-BIRTH
key_fields.meaning: Separately performed check that the date is strictly before today (INTEGER-OF-DATE comparison).

observations.text: On CSUTLDTC failure, GO TO EDIT-DATE-LE-EXIT falls into SET WS-EDIT-DATE-IS-VALID TO TRUE, resetting the part flags to valid although INPUT-ERROR remains set.

Each part edit's GO TO targets only its own exit paragraph (comment: 'Intentional violation of structured programming norms'), so a failing year still runs the month and day edits; only the first message is kept because of the WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF guard.
EDIT-MONTH tests WS-VALID-MONTH on the numeric redefinition before checking TEST-NUMVAL, so non-numeric month text is evaluated against a numeric 88-level first (Inferred).
Header refers to working storage 'CSUTLDTR'; the actual companion copybook is CSUTLDWY.
Date format mask 'YYYYMMDD' is fixed for the CSUTLDTC call.

purpose: Procedure-division copybook with reusable date edit paragraphs operating on the CSUTLDWY work fields and the caller's INPUT-ERROR, WS-RETURN-MSG and WS-EDIT-VARIABLE-NAME. PERFORM EDIT-DATE-CCYYMMDD THRU EDIT-DATE-CCYYMMDD-EXIT validates year (century 19/20), month, day, day/month combinations including leap years, and finally calls CSUTLDTC (LE date service); EDIT-DATE-OF-BIRTH rejects dates not before today. Only COACTUPC copies it, for open, expiry, reissue dates and date of birth.
